verb2/big-plate-hall.note: Night-coast hall — big but not cathedral

sat2/tape-slam.note: TAPE driven hard in parallel: drums squashed and fattened, transients kept

bus2/drum-bus.note: glue a kit: 4:1, 10 ms, AUTO, SC 90 Hz, a little color

drum2/808-boom.note: Deep 808 — long boomy kick, soft snare, dark hats
